outcome_csv_row.primary_outcome: Change from baseline in self-reported mean weekly pain intensity over 24 weeks
outcome_csv_row.primary_outcome_source: Methods: The primary outcome was the efficacy of botulinum toxin A versus placebo, measured as the change from baseline in self-reported mean weekly pain intensity over the course of 24 weeks from the first administration.
outcome_csv_row.anchor_as_printed: Botulinum toxin A reduced pain intensity over 24 weeks compared with placebo (adjusted effect estimate -0.77, 95% CI -0.95 to -0.59; p<0.0001)
